action.add.description: Button that adds an item to a list (a word, a sound, a graphic).

action.addAiProvider.description: Button that opens Settings › AI providers when a tool needs one.

action.back.description: Button that goes back to the previous view or step.

action.cancel.description: Button that closes a question or form without doing anything.

action.close.description: Button or label that closes a dialog or panel.

action.copy.description: Button that copies text or a file to the clipboard.

action.cut.description: Button (a verb) that cuts the selected part out of the video. The cut part itself is not this word.

action.delete.description: Button (a verb) that deletes something for good. Not the name of the Delete key.

action.deleteName.description: Accessible name of a delete button. {name} is what it deletes: a project, preset or version name.

action.done.description: Button that finishes a step and closes it.

action.hide.description: Button that hides something shown, such as a key.

action.keep.description: Button that keeps a suggested change or a version, the opposite of Remove.

action.later.description: Button that puts a question off until later.

action.makeCaptions.description: Button that makes captions from the recording’s sound.

action.play.description: Button that plays a sound, a clip or the video.

action.playName.description: Accessible name of a play button. {name} is the sound it plays.

action.refresh.description: Button that reads a list again.

action.regenerate.description: Button that makes the text or zooms again, replacing the ones made before.

action.remove.description: Button that removes an item from a list or the video.

action.removeAll.description: Button that removes every item of a list.

action.removeName.description: Accessible name of a remove button. {name} is what it removes: a folder, a chat, a font or a model.

action.reset.description: Button that puts the settings of a section back to their defaults.

action.restore.description: Button that brings back something cut or removed.

action.save.description: Button that saves a name, a style or a provider.

action.selectAll.description: Button that selects every item of a list.

action.show.description: Button that shows something hidden, or shows a file in its folder.

action.showInFolder.description: Button that opens the folder of a file in File Explorer, with the file selected.

action.stop.description: Button that stops a sound that plays or a job that runs.

action.tryAgain.description: Button that runs a job again after it failed.

action.use.description: Button that uses the item it sits on (a music bed, a zoom, a folder).

state.copied.description: Shown on a Copy button for a moment after it copied.

state.loading.description: Shown while a list or a preview loads.

state.none.description: Option of a select: nothing is chosen.

state.off.description: A setting that is turned off (an option, or the state shown beside a command).

state.saved.description: Shown when a change has been saved.

state.saving.description: Shown while a change is saved.

state.working.description: Shown on a button while its job runs.

label.background.description: Field label: what is behind the video, a caption or a title.

label.camera.description: Field or section label: the webcam.

label.captions.description: Section, track or field label: the captions of the video.

label.keyboardShortcuts.description: Name of the keyboard shortcuts dialog and of the buttons that open it.

label.layout.description: Section label: where things sit in the frame.

label.length.description: Field label: how long a clip, an item or a post is.

label.look.description: Section label: how something looks (its style).

label.motion.description: Section or field label: how something moves.

label.name.description: Field label: a name the user gives.

label.opacity.description: Slider label: how see-through something is.

label.position.description: Field label: where something sits in the frame.

label.provider.description: Field label: the AI provider used.

label.settings.description: Name of the Settings dialog and of the button that opens it.

label.shadow.description: Slider or section label: the shadow under something.

label.size.description: Slider label: how large something is drawn.

label.sound.description: Field label: the sound an item plays.

label.speed.description: Field label: how fast a clip or an animation plays.

label.strength.description: Slider label: how strong an effect is.

label.text.description: Field, track or section label: text on the video.

label.textColour.description: Field label: the colour of the text.

label.title.description: Field label: a title (of a card, a guide, an intro).

label.volume.description: Slider label: how loud a sound is.

label.zoom.description: Track, button or slider label: zooming in on the video.

colour.pickAny.description: Tooltip of the swatch that opens the colour picker.

colour.anyFor.description: Accessible name of the colour picker after a row of swatches. {label} is the row’s label, such as Background.

error.drawingSurface.description: Error when the graphics card gives no canvas to draw frames on.
